attrs.citation: OMG Structured Assurance Case Metamodel (SACM) 2.3, formally adopted October 2023
hypotheses: none — it is a metamodel, not a theorem
attrs.note: Verified at omg.org 2026-08-24. Cited for the conceptual separation ONLY. Nothing here imports the metamodel, and a metamodel is not a result that can discharge an obligation — which is why no claim consumes it as a cited_result.
attrs.result: An assurance case is a set of auditable CLAIMS, ARGUMENTS and EVIDENCE, framed by CONTEXT and ASSUMPTIONS, supporting the claim that a system satisfies stated requirements.
